caption: Grains of rice lie on the head of a snare drum; the drum is struck once with a stick and the grains jump.
expectation: The grains are still until the strike, leap up together at the strike and settle back within a second or two as the head goes quiet; they do not move before the stick lands.

caption: The low string of an acoustic guitar is plucked, and the string blurs into a wide band before slowly sharpening to a line again.
expectation: Only the plucked string blurs, the blur is widest right after the pluck and narrows steadily; the other strings stay sharp.

caption: A gong is struck once with a padded mallet, and a ping-pong ball hanging on a thread against its face is knocked away and swings.
expectation: The ball rests against the gong until the strike, is thrown outward the instant the gong sounds and swings back and forth, tapping the gong again as it returns while it rings; the ball does not move before the strike.

caption: A steel ruler is held flat on a desk with part sticking over the edge; the free end is flicked and it waggles up and down before coming to rest.
expectation: The free end vibrates fast right after the flick with the tip blurring, the swings get smaller, and it stops within seconds; the part held on the desk stays still.

caption: A taut rubber band stretched between two nails is flicked, and the band blurs and hums before going still.
expectation: The band becomes a fuzzy band right after the flick and narrows back to a line; it does not start moving on its own.

caption: A wine glass half full of water is tapped on the rim with a spoon, and the water surface inside breaks into fine ripples while the glass rings.
expectation: The ripples appear only at the tap and fade as the ringing dies; the glass itself is not seen moving and the water does not slosh as if the glass had been shaken.

caption: A struck tuning fork is dipped into a glass of water, and the water sprays up where the prongs touch it.
expectation: The water is still before the prongs reach it, spray and ripples burst out only at the moment of contact and only while the prongs touch the surface, and the surface settles once the fork is lifted; the spray does not start before contact or continue with the fork out of the water.

caption: A single string of an upright bass is plucked, and the thick string swings visibly from side to side before settling.
expectation: The swing is widest right after the pluck and shrinks steadily; the string does not stop dead or swing wider on its own.

caption: A large cymbal is struck, and the cymbal wobbles on its stand and its edge blurs before it steadies.
expectation: The wobble and blur begin at the strike and die away over several seconds; the cymbal does not move before the stick reaches it.

caption: Grains of rice lie on an upturned metal pot lid on a table; the lid is struck once with a spoon and the grains jump.
expectation: The grains are still before the strike, jump up together at the moment of the strike and land back on the lid or scatter off its edge; they do not jump before the strike or keep jumping once the lid is quiet.

caption: A small scrap of paper rests on a bass string inside a grand piano with the lid open; the key for that string is pressed, and the paper jumps off the string.
expectation: The paper lies still until the key is pressed, is flicked up and off the string the instant the note sounds, and falls onto neighbouring strings or the frame; only the struck string's paper moves, and it does not jump before the key goes down or float back into place.

caption: A few grains of salt lie on a xylophone bar; the bar is struck with a mallet and the grains jump off.
expectation: The salt is still until the strike, leaps off the bar at the strike and does not return; only the struck bar's salt moves.

caption: A thin sheet-metal door is knocked on, and the panel visibly flexes and rattles under the knocks before going quiet.
expectation: The panel moves at each knock and the rattle dies out between knocks; the door does not keep shaking after the knocking stops.

caption: A long wooden fishing rod is tapped against a post, and the tip whips back and forth in a blur before settling.
expectation: The tip's swings are large right after the tap and shrink steadily; the handle end barely moves.

caption: The taut mat of a trampoline is slapped with a hand, and the mat ripples outward and shivers before going flat.
expectation: The ripples spread from the slap and the shiver fades within a second or two; the mat is flat before the slap.

caption: A stretched washing line is plucked, and the line blurs along its length and slowly sharpens.
expectation: The blur begins at the pluck and shrinks toward stillness; the clothes on the line sway slightly and settle.

caption: A long steel saw blade is dropped flat onto a bench, and the blade twangs and flutters for a moment before lying still.
expectation: The flutter starts at the impact and fades quickly; the blade does not keep quivering.

caption: The top of a large empty cardboard box is thumped, and the lid panel bounces and quivers before settling.
expectation: The panel moves at the thump and the quiver fades within a second; the box's sides barely move.

caption: A metal spring doorstop mounted on the wall is flicked, and it wobbles wildly and then slows to a stop.
expectation: The wobble is largest right after the flick and shrinks steadily; the base on the wall does not move.

caption: Small paper riders sit on the strings of an acoustic guitar; the body of the guitar is tapped with a palm and the riders jump.
expectation: The riders lie still until the tap, hop or fall off at the tap, and do not move again once the strings are quiet; the strings are not plucked.

caption: The taut head of a large bass drum is slapped, and the head visibly dips and rebounds several times, each time smaller.
expectation: The first dip is deepest, each rebound is smaller, and the head is flat within a couple of seconds.

caption: The wire of a garden fence is plucked, and the wire blurs and hums along its span before settling.
expectation: The blur is greatest at the plucked point and fades along the wire; it stops when the wire is gripped.

caption: Salt is sprinkled on the bars of a marimba; a mallet runs across the bars and the salt jumps off each bar in turn.
expectation: Salt leaves each bar only as that bar is struck, in the order the mallet travels; bars not yet struck keep their salt still.

caption: The thin elastic cord of a paddle ball toy is plucked, and the cord blurs and the ball bounces lightly before both go still.
expectation: The blur and bounce begin at the pluck and decay within a couple of seconds.

caption: A strip of thin sheet metal clamped at one end in a vise is flicked, and the free end vibrates in a blur that slowly stops.
expectation: The free end blurs widest at the tip right after the flick and narrows to stillness; the clamped end does not move.

caption: The taut skin of a tambourine is struck, and the skin shivers and the metal jingles rattle before quieting.
expectation: The skin shiver and the jingle rattle both begin at the strike and fade together within a second or two.

caption: A glass of water sits on top of a large subwoofer, and when the music starts the water's surface breaks into fine ripples.
expectation: The ripples appear only when the music plays, pulse with the bass, and the surface goes flat when the music stops; the glass does not slide off.

caption: A heavy truck rumbles past a house, and a teaspoon resting on a stack of plates by the window jiggles and chatters against the top plate.
expectation: The spoon starts to jiggle as the truck approaches, moves most as it passes and lies still after it has gone; it does not move in a quiet street.

caption: A heavy door is slammed shut, and a picture frame on the nearby wall swings from side to side before hanging still.
expectation: The frame starts swinging at the slam, the swings grow smaller, and it stops within a few seconds; it does not move before the slam.

caption: Thunder rolls over a house, and a strip of paper taped to a loose window pane quivers with each rumble.
expectation: The strip flutters only during the rumbles and hangs still between them; it does not flutter before the thunder or keep fluttering afterwards.

caption: A washing machine spins up to full speed, and the bottle of detergent standing on top of it shakes and creeps toward the edge.
expectation: The shaking begins as the machine spins up, the bottle inches along in small jumps, and it stops moving when the spin cycle ends.

caption: A marching band's bass drum passes close to a shop window, and a paper sign taped to the inside of the glass quivers with each beat.
expectation: The sign twitches in time with the drum beats and is still between them and after the band has passed; it does not move before the drum sounds.

caption: A subway train roars through a station, and a hanging sign on the platform trembles on its chains.
expectation: The trembling starts with the train's arrival, is strongest as it passes, and fades after it leaves.

caption: A speaker on a table plays a loud bass track, and a handful of grains of rice scattered on the table jump and dance around it.
expectation: The grains hop in time with the beats, most strongly nearest the speaker, and lie still when the track stops.

caption: A jackhammer starts up on a street, and the coffee in cups on a café terrace table shows rings of tiny ripples.
expectation: The ripples appear when the hammer runs and vanish when it pauses; cups farther away ripple less.

caption: A car with a booming stereo pulls up at a light, and the fuzzy dice hanging from its rear-view mirror jiggle with the bass.
expectation: The dice twitch in time with the beats and hang still when the music is turned down; they do not swing on their own.

caption: A loud table saw in a workshop is switched on, and the screws in a jar on the bench begin to rattle and shift.
expectation: The rattling begins when the saw starts and stops when it is switched off; the screws settle in a slightly different arrangement.

caption: A low-flying jet passes over a house, and a hanging light fitting in the hallway swings gently.
expectation: The swing starts as the jet passes and dies down over several seconds; the fitting is still beforehand.

caption: A subwoofer is turned up in a living room, and a picture frame on the wall behind it slowly tilts askew with the bass.
expectation: The frame creeps out of level only while the bass plays, in small jerks, and stays where it ends up when the music stops; it does not straighten itself.

caption: A hard rhythm is played on a drum kit in a small room, and a glass of water on a nearby amplifier ripples with each hit.
expectation: Each ripple ring appears with a drum hit and fades before the next; the surface is calm when the drumming stops.

caption: A door slams in a hallway, and a set of keys hanging on a hook beside it swings and jingles.
expectation: The keys start swinging at the slam and settle within a few seconds; they hang still before.

caption: A powerful motorcycle revs its engine at a kerb, and the leaves of a potted plant on the pavement beside it quiver.
expectation: The leaves shake while the engine revs and go still when it idles down.

caption: A concert speaker stack blasts a bass note, and the fabric grille on its front visibly pulses in and out.
expectation: The grille flutters in time with the low notes and lies flat when the music stops.

caption: A helicopter hovers low over a field, and the surface of a pond beneath it shivers into fine ripples.
expectation: The ripples appear while the helicopter is overhead and fade after it flies away; the water is calm before.

caption: A loud speaker plays a rising bass tone next to a tray of sand, and the sand grains jump and shift into patterns.
expectation: The grains move only while the tone plays and stop when it stops; grains nearest the speaker move most.

caption: An excavator drops a load of rubble into a steel skip, and a nearby chain-link fence shivers along its length.
expectation: The shiver starts at the crash and fades within seconds; the fence is still before.

caption: A phone on vibrate buzzes on a glass table, and a spoon lying next to it rattles against the glass.
expectation: The spoon rattles in bursts with the phone's buzzes and lies still between them.

caption: A train crosses a metal bridge, and the water in a puddle on the road below shows shivering rings.
expectation: The rings appear as the train crosses and fade after it has passed; the puddle is still before.

caption: A stadium crowd stamps in unison, and the beer in a cup on a railing shows a steady wobble in time with the stamps.
expectation: The wobble matches the rhythm of the stamping and settles when the crowd stops.

caption: A heavy cast-iron pan is dropped onto a stovetop, and the lids of neighbouring pots rattle for a moment.
expectation: The rattle starts at the impact and stops within a second or two; the lids are still before.

caption: A speaker on the floor of a room plays a deep bass note, and a lit candle on the same floor flickers in time with the beats.
expectation: The flame flutters with each beat and burns steady when the music stops.

caption: A chainsaw is revved in a garage, and the tools hanging on the pegboard behind it sway and tap against the board.
expectation: The tools move while the saw runs and hang still when it is shut off.

caption: A large speaker's cone pumps in and out as a bass-heavy track plays, and it stops moving when the music is paused.
expectation: The cone moves in time with the beats, more on the low notes, and is still the instant the music pauses; it does not move in silence.

caption: A phone set to vibrate buzzes on a wooden table and creeps slowly across the surface until the buzzing stops.
expectation: The phone shivers and moves only while it buzzes, in small jerks; it stops dead when the vibration ends.

caption: An electric toothbrush is switched on and left lying on a bathroom counter, and it buzzes and slowly turns in circles.
expectation: The brush moves only while switched on and stops as soon as it is turned off.

caption: A struck tuning fork is brought up to a ping-pong ball hanging on a thread, and the ball is kicked away and swings.
expectation: The ball hangs still until the prongs touch it, is knocked outward on contact and swings back, being kicked again if it returns to the ringing fork; nothing moves before contact.

caption: A coin stands balanced on the hood of a car idling roughly, and it jitters and topples over.
expectation: The coin trembles in place while the engine runs and eventually falls flat, staying down; it does not move before the engine starts or stand back up.

caption: A small paper rider sits on the string of a cello; a bow is drawn across that string and the rider is thrown off.
expectation: The rider stays put until the bow touches the string, is flicked off as soon as the string sounds and does not return; riders on other strings stay still.

caption: A wind-up alarm clock rings, and its little hammer hammers between the two bells and the clock shivers on the table.
expectation: The hammer swings rapidly and the clock shakes only while it rings; both stop when the button is pressed.

caption: A hand-held massager is switched on and set on a bed, and it shudders and wanders across the sheet.
expectation: The shudder and wandering start with the switch and stop with it; the massager is still when off.

caption: A blender runs on a kitchen counter, and its base vibrates and inches slightly across the counter until it is switched off.
expectation: The movement happens only while the motor runs and stops when it is turned off.

caption: A lawnmower is started, and its handle shakes visibly until the engine is cut.
expectation: The shaking lasts as long as the engine runs and stops when it is switched off.

caption: The pedal of a bass drum is pressed repeatedly, and the beater swings into the drumhead with each press and the head dips each time.
expectation: The beater moves only when the pedal is pressed and the head dips only when the beater lands; nothing moves between presses.

caption: A washing machine on its spin cycle rocks and shudders on the floor, and it settles still as the drum slows to a stop.
expectation: The shuddering is strongest at full spin and dies away as the drum slows; the machine is still once the drum stops.

caption: A large bell in a tower is rung by a rope, and it swings back and forth with the clapper striking it on each swing.
expectation: The bell swings only while the rope is pulled and its swings die down once the pulling stops.

caption: A desk fan with a bent blade is switched on, and the whole fan wobbles visibly on its base as the blades spin.
expectation: The wobble starts as the blades spin up, keeps a steady rhythm while they turn, and is absent when the blades are still; the fan does not wobble before it is switched on.

caption: A pager on vibrate goes off on a nightstand and rattles against the wood until it stops.
expectation: The rattling and small movements happen only while it vibrates and end when it is lifted.

caption: Sand is sprinkled on a cymbal and a violin bow is drawn along its edge, and the sand jumps and gathers into lines.
expectation: The sand lies still until the bow moves, dances while the bow is drawn and collects into lines or patches, and settles when the bow lifts; no pattern forms before the bow touches the cymbal.

caption: A generator runs on a building site, and its frame shakes and the loose bolts on it rattle until it is shut down.
expectation: The shaking lasts as long as the engine runs and stops within a moment of shutdown.

caption: The keys of a toy piano are banged, and the small hammers inside can be seen jumping up with each key press.
expectation: Each hammer moves only when its key is pressed and falls back after; hammers of unpressed keys stay down.

caption: A paint shaker at a hardware store is switched on, and the paint can clamped in it blurs with the shaking until the timer stops it.
expectation: The can blurs only while the machine runs and is sharp and still when it stops.

caption: Grains of rice lie on the head of a banjo; a string is plucked and the grains jump.
expectation: The grains are still until the pluck, jump at the pluck and settle as the note fades; they do not move before the string is plucked.

caption: A dental drill is switched on and held up, and its tip becomes a blur until the pedal is released.
expectation: The tip blurs only while the drill runs and is sharp when it stops.

caption: A stand mixer runs on high, and the whole mixer trembles on the counter until it is turned down.
expectation: The trembling is strongest on high and eases as the speed is lowered; it stops when the mixer is off.

caption: A microphone on a stand is tapped, and the mic head jiggles on its clip with each tap.
expectation: The jiggle begins with each tap and settles before the next; the mic is still without tapping.

caption: The figurine on a wind-up music box turns slower and slower as the spring runs down, and finally stops.
expectation: The turning only slows, never speeds up, easing smoothly to a stop and then staying still; the figurine does not jerk, reverse, or start again after stopping; the mechanism inside need not be visible.
